title: Superpower stories carousel
description: Member stories on a faint grey band: a rating line, a two-line headline and a grey lead, then a row of wide slides (a rounded photo, the member's name and age, a quote and a grey outcome line) separated by hairlines. It plays by itself: the active slide is full strength, the rest at half; under it a segmented bar where the current segment widens and fills over a few seconds before the row glides on, with a '2 / 5' counter.
notes: autoplay pauses on hover, while the row is off-screen, and entirely under reduced motion (the segments stay clickable)
rewinds to the first story after the last one
